how_it_assembles: positive = style_lock + ' ' + (character_lock if use_character) + ' ' + variation ; negative = negative_base + (', ' + negative_extra if negative_extra)

base.style_lock: Vertical mobile game key visual, portrait 9:19.5 composition. Art direction: a vast deep navy-blue void (#0A0E1A) fading to near-black (#020409) at the edges, electric cyan (#38E1FF) as the single dominant accent, pale ice-cyan (#9FF0FF) highlights and near-white (#E9FBFF) bloom. Gamified holographic sci-fi interface language: semi-transparent glass panels with bevelled chamfered corners and thin glowing cyan edges, hairline hexagonal data lattice, faint horizontal scanlines, a thin cyan wireframe floor grid receding toward a glowing horizon, volumetric cyan light shafts, drifting luminous particles and small cyan bokeh, soft vignette, very dark and low contrast in the background so bright user-interface text stays readable. Rarity colour system reserved strictly as signal, never as ambience: F gray #9AA3B2, E green #4ADE80, D blue #38BDF8, C purple #A78BFA, B gold #FBBF24, A orange #FB923C, S red #FF4D5E. Cinematic lighting, crisp anime line art, ultra-detailed polished digital painting, premium sci-fi game user interface, high-end mobile game key art.
base.character_lock: The protagonist is a virtual girl: an anime cel-shaded Live2D-style character with flat clean line art, cool-toned pale skin, shoulder-length dark navy hair with one electric-cyan highlight strand, calm half-lidded eyes and a faint condescending smirk, slim build, wearing a simple dark high-collared sleeveless uniform dress with thin glowing cyan seams and a small chest emblem, bare arms, no warm ambient light on her skin. She is rendered as a semi-transparent holographic projection: her silhouette dissolves into fine scanlines and cyan light at the edges, a thin cyan rim light runs along her contour, with subtle chromatic aberration on the rim.
base.negative_base: western wanted poster, bounty poster, aged yellow paper, rope, blood stamp, sepia tone, warm colour dominance, orange and teal grading, neon rainbow gradient, oversaturated, plastic 3D render, photorealistic, realistic human, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, asymmetrical eyes, cluttered composition, busy background, high contrast centre, bright daylight, watermark, signature, logo, jpeg artifacts, low resolution, blurry
base.text_rule: Qwen-Image 2.1 能写中文，但一屏最多给 6 个短标签；长段落一律不写进图里，交给 CSS 叠字。所有整屏稿都在 variation 里显式声明允许出现的文字，其余一律 no extra text。

shots.title: 系统娘 · 设定三视图
shots.desc: 她本人的唯一视觉真源。一眼要能看出这是个能活起来的 Live2D 角色：平涂上色、干净线稿、冷调皮肤、青色的边缘光。这一张定下来，后面 20 多屏全部锁它，不许漂移。
shots.variation: Character reference sheet on a flat dark navy background, no interface elements at all. Three views of the same girl side by side: full-body front, full-body three-quarter, full-body back, plus a row of five head close-ups along the bottom showing her expression range (calm smirk, annoyed frown, cold flat stare, wide-eyed surprise, softly pleased). Clean turnaround layout, thin cyan guide lines, small empty annotation boxes with no writing. Identical proportions, hair and outfit across every view. Text: none.
shots.negative_extra: text, letters, numbers, multiple different characters, inconsistent outfit
shots.notes: 锁定用。抽到满意的一张后把它当风格参照，后续所有整屏稿都用同一 seed 家族。

shots.title: 表情差分表 · 九种情绪
shots.desc: 她的情绪不是贴纸，是参数级的：眼睑、眼笑、眉、嘴角、脸红、呼吸。这张表用来校准九种基准表情的眉眼口形，Flutter 侧和 Live2D 参数都照它调。
shots.variation: Expression sheet, head and shoulders only, nine head close-ups arranged in a clean three by three grid on a flat dark navy background, no interface. The nine expressions in order: neutral calm, focused narrowed eyes, smug smirk, cold flat stare, annoyed frown, tsundere flustered blush looking away, sad downcast eyes, wide-eyed surprise, softly pleased smile. Consistent face, hair and lighting across all nine. Thin cyan separator lines between cells. Text: none.
shots.negative_extra: text, letters, numbers, different faces, inconsistent hair
shots.notes: 校准用。对不上就以 C0 那张为准重抽。

shots.title: 天幕 · 虚空舞台（无人物）
shots.desc: 她身后的世界。整屏最底层，垫在 CSS 的扫描线、噪点、地面网格之下。她会被合成在正中央，所以中心必须空、必须暗。新增一层：竖着一摞椭圆的环轨虚影，从下往上排，等着她站进去。
shots.variation: Empty stage background, absolutely no people and no characters and no text. A huge circular holographic array of thin glowing electric-cyan concentric rings floats in the upper third like a high-tech summoning circle seen face-on, its centre left completely empty. A vertical stack of seven faint elliptical ring tracks recedes upward through the middle of the frame, dim and dashed, empty and waiting. Far below, a barely visible holographic floor of thin cyan grid lines recedes toward a glowing horizon. Fine luminous particles drift, faint hexagonal data patterns and subtle scanlines dissolve into darkness, thin wisps of fog catch the light near the floor. Dead centre stays clean, dark and low contrast.
shots.negative_extra: people, person, character, girl, face, body, hands, text, letters, numbers
shots.notes: 直接替换 prototype/opus-v2-dir/img/bg-void.jpg，落 1080x2340 网页版。

shots.title: 粒子素材 · 辉光与拖尾
shots.desc: 结算炸开、升级、刻字火星、环亮，全靠这几个 sprite。要加色混合友好：黑底、亮核、边缘干净。
shots.variation: Sprite sheet on a pure black background, eight isolated effects laid out in a clean grid, additive-blend ready, no text: a radial glow burst with a white-hot core, a thin ring shockwave, a comet trail with a tapering tail, a cluster of soft cyan bokeh, a spray of sharp spark streaks, a hexagonal shard shatter, a soft light haze puff, and a fine particle dust cloud. Each effect fully separated with generous black spacing, bright cores fading cleanly to black at the edges, electric cyan and white.
shots.negative_extra: text, letters, numbers, background scenery, characters
shots.notes: 切图后在 Flutter 侧做 CustomPainter 的贴图，不做视频。

shots.title: 印章纹章 · CRIT / 双倍
shots.desc: 暴击和双倍卡盖章那一下的分量，全在这两枚章上。要有雕刻金属感、边缘磨损，不是贴纸。
shots.variation: Two circular emblem stamp designs on a pure black background, isolated and centred, no text other than the two short uppercase captions. The left stamp is a starburst-edged circular seal with the word CRIT in bold condensed uppercase across its middle, engraved metallic texture, distressed worn edges, glowing electric cyan ink. The right stamp is a doubled hexagon seal with a large multiplication sign in its centre and a short uppercase caption below, engraved, in the same cyan ink. Hard-edged, high contrast, silkscreen poster quality.
shots.negative_extra: photorealistic paper, ink smudge, yellowed paper
shots.notes: S 级红色变体可用负提示词里去掉 cyan 后换 rarity 色重抽。

shots.title: glitch 帧与扫描线贴图
shots.desc: 转场、觉醒、S 级降临时那一下信号错乱。要可平铺、要能被 CSS 或着色器直接叠。
shots.variation: Glitch and overlay texture sheet on a black background, four separate tiles with clean spacing, no text: a horizontal band of RGB-split scanline corruption in cyan and white, a seamless tileable fine scanline overlay, a seamless tileable faint hexagonal data lattice, and a blocky datamosh tear with sharp rectangular displacement. High contrast, crisp, designed to be composited with additive and screen blending.
shots.negative_extra: text, letters, numbers, scenery, characters, blurry mess
shots.notes: 全部要能无缝平铺。

shots.title: 开机自检 · 唤醒
shots.desc: 打开 App 的第一秒不是首页，是开机自检。她闭着眼悬在容器里，日志一行行滚出来，底下写着「触碰屏幕 · 唤醒系统」。你点一下她才睁眼。这一屏的任务是让人意识到：进的是另一个地方，不是打开了一个工具。
shots.variation: She is asleep: eyes closed, head tilted slightly down, floating upright in the centre of the dark void inside a tall cylindrical containment field of thin cyan light. Her body is dimmed to about one third brightness, desaturated, edges dissolving into scanlines. Overlaid on the void is a minimal boot self-test interface: a thin cyan progress bar near the bottom, four short lines of system log text in a monospaced terminal font stacked above it, a tiny clock at the top right, and a centred uppercase prompt reading TOUCH TO WAKE with a small pulsing ring around it. No other interface elements. Text allowed: four short monospaced log lines and one uppercase prompt.
shots.negative_extra: awake eyes, bright colours, cheerful
shots.notes: 她必须是睡着的、暗的、半透明的。整屏亮度压到最低。

shots.title: 绑定仪式 · 报名
shots.desc: 首次进入，她刚醒。第一句是「……就你？」，第二句开始问你叫什么。没有注册页、没有引导浮层、没有「开始使用」按钮，只有她说话，和两个你回她的按钮。
shots.variation: She has just woken: eyes open, head lifted, looking directly at the viewer with a faint smirk, three-quarter body, standing inside her ring tracks. In the lower third of the screen there are two stacked glass choice buttons, each a long translucent bar with a thin cyan edge, and above them a single-line dialogue card holding two short lines of Simplified Chinese dialogue in a clean sans-serif, with a small five-bar audio waveform icon at its left. Behind her, a very large word in a thin display typeface sits at low opacity. Text allowed: two short Simplified Chinese button labels and two short Simplified Chinese dialogue lines.
shots.negative_extra: registration form, onboarding tutorial overlay, start button, checkbox list
shots.notes: 背景大字是 SYSTEM，低不透明度，不许抢她的脸。

shots.title: 立目标 · 一句梦话被当场驳回
shots.desc: 宿主输入一句话目标，比如「变优秀」。她当场驳回——太虚了，拆不动。这一屏要让人知道：这个系统不陪你许愿，它只接能拆成环的目标。
shots.variation: She leans forward slightly with an annoyed frown, one eyebrow raised, one hand lifted as if rejecting an idea. In the lower third of the screen there is a glowing text input bar with a row of four small rounded glass preset chips above it, each holding a short Simplified Chinese phrase. A dialogue card above the input holds one short line of Simplified Chinese dialogue. Behind her the faint background word is being overwritten by a new one. Text allowed: four short Simplified Chinese preset phrases, one input placeholder, one short Simplified Chinese dialogue line.
shots.negative_extra: keyboard, form validation error, red warning box
shots.notes: 她的表情是「不耐烦」，不是「生气」。

shots.title: 拆环 · 环从脚下挂到头顶
shots.desc: 全屏最用力的一处。一句话目标被她拆成 5~8 环，一环一环从脚下挂到头顶，每亮一环就「叮」一声。最后最高那一环亮起时放烟花。她要站在环里面，不是贴在环上面。
shots.variation: Wide full-body shot: she stands at the exact centre while seven concentric elliptical holographic rings ignite one after another from her feet up to above her head. Each ring is a thin glowing cyan track with tick marks; the front half of every ring is drawn in front of her body and the back half behind it, so she stands inside them. Brightness steps down with height: the lowest rings are solid and blazing, the highest are dashed and dim. Small floating label tags hang at the right end of each ring. A wide cyan particle burst and a white flash at the highest ring. Text allowed: seven tiny ring index labels reading R1 through R7.
shots.negative_extra: progress bar, linear progress track, dashboard
shots.notes: 关键是「她站在环里」——环必须在她身前身后各画半圈。

shots.title: 大厅 · 她记得你走了多久
shots.desc: 日常待机。你回来，她先念出你走了多久（10 分钟 / 2 小时 / 12 小时 / 36 小时 / 好几天，语气逐档变冷）。四周浮着常驻 HUD：左上等级六边牌带经验弧，中间你的名字和称号，右上金币，底部三个图标页签加中央一颗巨大的委托按钮。
shots.variation: Idle lobby: she stands relaxed at the centre with her weight on one leg, looking slightly to the side, one ring track glowing beneath her feet. Around the screen edges float the always-on game HUD: at the top left a hexagonal level badge with a thin experience arc and a number inside, at the top centre the host name with an honourific title and a small streak counter, at the top right a hexagonal coin counter, at the top centre also a small pill reading a running timer. Along the bottom is a navigation bar with three small icon tabs on the left and one large circular central button ringed by two thin orbiting arcs, with a short caption under it. Text allowed: a few short uppercase labels and numbers.
shots.negative_extra: card list, to-do list, feed, chat bubbles
shots.notes: 常驻层的基准屏。HUD 全部贴边，中心永远留给她。

shots.title: 派单 · 一块被她刻上字的玻璃
shots.desc: 派单不是弹一条通知，是一块全息玻璃朝你砸下来落定。右上角稀有度骰子从 F 滚到目标等级（S 级会在 A 上停一拍），然后她当着你的面用激光把字一行行烧上去。分量来自材质与动作，不是边框。
shots.variation: She has just thrown a slab of holographic glass toward the camera: a large translucent rectangular panel hovers in mid-air in front of her, tilted slightly, with a chamfered bevelled edge, a moving specular sheen sweeping across its surface, and a bright laser line burning a row of text into it with tiny sparks flying off. On the panel top right corner sits a hexagonal rarity dial with seven tick marks and one big letter; below it a title, two short paragraphs, and a three-row dotted specification table. She stands behind the panel with one arm still extended, looking straight at the viewer with a focused expression. Text allowed: one big rarity letter, one short Simplified Chinese task title, a few short Simplified Chinese labels.
shots.negative_extra: notification card, mobile push banner, rounded app card, paper document
shots.notes: 禁止出现黄纸、绳、血印——上一版被字面执行成通缉令，这一轮硬约束。

shots.title: 按住指纹 · 接单
shots.desc: 接单不是点按钮，是按 0.9 秒指纹不回弹。中途松手会被她抓包：「……犹豫了？」这是整个产品里唯一一件你需要付出一点点力气才能做到的事——分量的来源。
shots.variation: Close-up on the lower area of the floating glass panel: a large fingerprint made of seven concentric fingerprint arcs glows bright cyan, filled about seventy percent from the outside in, with a progress caption below it reading a hold-to-confirm prompt in Simplified Chinese and a percentage. Behind the panel she is slightly out of focus, leaning in and watching closely with narrowed focused eyes. Text allowed: one short Simplified Chinese hold prompt and one uppercase English caption.
shots.negative_extra: fingerprint scanner hardware, real hand, thumb
shots.notes: 指纹是七条同心弧，不是真实指纹纹理。

shots.title: 退缩 · 稀有度往下掉一档
shots.desc: 你说「换一个」，她就当场把这一单降一档，报酬重刻。退三次，强制给你挂上「口头巨人」称号——嘴不豁免记录。这一屏要让退缩有代价，但代价是可承受的。
shots.variation: She has a cold, unimpressed expression, arms crossed, chin slightly raised. The glass panel in front of her is flickering and its rarity dial has just dropped: the big letter is dimmer and only part of the seven tick marks are lit, while the reward line on the panel is being re-etched by a bright laser with fresh sparks. A banner strip has slid in at the top of the screen showing a forced title being pinned onto the host, with a small warning glyph. Text allowed: one big rarity letter, one short Simplified Chinese title, one short banner label.
shots.negative_extra: angry shouting, red alert, punishment screen
shots.notes: 她是「冷」，不是「凶」。

shots.title: 执行中 · 她盯着你
shots.desc: 计时开始，她退到右边看着你。左边是执行面板：大计时器、进度条、一行「SYSTEM 正在看着你」、三个虚线证据槽（真能选图）、暴击率、道具抽屉，底部【提交任务】和按住认输。整个场景为她之外的界面压暗。
shots.variation: She has stepped back and to the right of frame, three-quarter body, looking at the viewer with narrowed focused eyes. The left two thirds of the screen are covered by a tall execution panel of stacked glass cards: a big running timer in a wide monospaced font, a thin progress bar with a small limit label, a line reading that the system is watching with a small eye glyph, a row of three dashed square evidence slots with one filled by a photo thumbnail, a crit-chance readout with two small item tags beside it, and at the bottom two ghost action buttons plus a hold-to-surrender bar. The whole scene behind the panel is dimmed. Text allowed: one timer readout, a few short Simplified Chinese labels, one crit percentage.
shots.negative_extra: stopwatch hardware, clock face, calendar
shots.notes: 面板压暗场景，但她不许被压掉——她永远可见。

shots.title: 结算 · 稀有度砸落 + EXP 上涨
shots.desc: 一秒的「给」。证据飞进她手里，她扫一眼；稀有度字母砸进屏幕；EXP 数字往上跳；经验条上涨；金币、六维、连击一枚枚 chip 浮起来；她头顶那一环亮起。你只需要看着，不需要点。这一屏要让人想截图。
shots.variation: She is looking straight at the viewer with a proud self-satisfied expression, one hand on her hip, the ring tracks around her brightening. A huge rarity letter slams into the centre of the screen with a hard-edged glow and radiating shockwave rings, particles bursting outward. Below it a stacked result card holds an uppercase kicker line, a big EXP number counting up, a thin experience bar, a level readout, and three small reward chips. Two thin scan lines sweep across the screen. Maximum bloom and contrast, this is the brightest frame in the whole app. Text allowed: one huge rarity letter, one big EXP number, a few short uppercase kickers.
shots.negative_extra: confetti, party popper, cartoon celebration
shots.notes: 整屏最亮的一帧。稀有度色只在字母和印章上出现。

shots.title: 暴击 / 双倍卡 · 盖章
shots.desc: 命中暴击：数字定格 200ms，盖上 CRIT 印章，再翻倍续滚；身上带双倍卡再盖一枚。两枚章砸下去的质感，是这一屏的全部。
shots.variation: Same result layout as a clear screen, but the numbers have been doubled and two heavy circular ink stamps have just been slammed onto the result card, one reading a crit multiplier and one reading a double-item multiplier, each with a starburst edge, engraved metallic cyan texture, distressed edges, and a burst of particles behind it. She throws her head back slightly, eyes wide with surprise. Text allowed: one big number, two short uppercase stamp captions.
shots.negative_extra: paper stamp, ink pad, rubber stamp object
shots.notes: 章是「光刻」质感，不是实体橡皮章。

shots.title: 升级 · LEVEL UP
shots.desc: 经验跨级：先涨满 → 白闪 → 归零 → 再涨到余额。白闪那一帧就是这一屏：LEVEL UP 砸出来，她欢呼，脚边最内那一环点亮。日委托上限 +1，难度也跟着涨。
shots.variation: A full-screen white flash at the exact moment of level-up: she is mid-cheer with both arms raised slightly, eyes bright, hair and uniform lifted by the shockwave. A large level-up banner is centred holding a small uppercase kicker, a huge level number, and one short line of small text. The lowest ring track around her has ignited into a solid blazing band. Cyan particles explode outward in a wide cone. Text allowed: one uppercase kicker, one huge number, one short Simplified Chinese line.
shots.negative_extra: gold coins raining, treasure chest, fireworks cartoon
shots.notes: 升级总时长 ≤2s；同日重复只播简版。

shots.title: 认输 · 更暗、更安静、更短
shots.desc: 按住认输。画面整体压暗、饱和度抽掉，没有冲击音，字幕比平时更慢更短。她念出你真实的连败数据——毒舌就是惩罚本身。难受，但不羞辱。
shots.variation: The scene is drained and quiet: overall saturation cut to roughly one third, brightness reduced, a heavy dark vignette closing in from every edge, no particles at all. She stands with her head lowered and eyes closed, shoulders dropped, hands at her sides, her holographic rim light almost extinguished. A single narrow record strip near the bottom shows a surrender timestamp, and a small muted card begins to fade in beneath it. A very thin surrender progress line stretches across the bottom edge. Text allowed: one short Simplified Chinese record line.
shots.negative_extra: game over screen, skull, red X, harsh punishment
shots.notes: 失败亮度＝成功的三分之一。全程不许有暖色。

shots.title: 补救 · 永远留一条路
shots.desc: 在同一块板上，她已经给你备好了补救单：明天此时之前做一半，这一笔就划掉。「永远有补救」是机制，也是她这个角色的底线。
shots.variation: Still the drained dark scene, but one small panel has lit up on the board in front of her: a remedy card with an uppercase kicker, one task title, a half-duration note and a deadline, its edge glowing in soft neutral cyan rather than any warm colour. She has raised her head and is looking at the viewer with a flat patient expression. Two choice buttons sit below the card. Text allowed: one short Simplified Chinese title, one deadline line, two short Simplified Chinese button labels.
shots.negative_extra: warm hopeful glow, sunrise, redemption light
shots.notes: 补救卡不许用暖色。希望是靠机制给的，不是靠打光给的。

shots.title: 主线全景 · 环套在她身上
shots.desc: 主线不是进度条，是天花板。5~8 环全部套在她身上：已走过＝实心发光的环，脚下这一环＝一颗彗星沿环慢慢扫永不停，还没到＝虚线暗轨悬着。点任一环看要求。她说话时环跟着呼吸，她打瞌睡时环变慢。你离她还有多远，是看得见的。
shots.variation: Wide full-body shot of her standing inside a vertical stack of seven concentric elliptical holographic ring tracks climbing from the floor at her feet to far above her head. Completed rings are solid and blazing with tick marks; the ring at her feet carries a small comet of light travelling around it; the rings above are dashed dim rails. Small labels hang at the right end of each ring. At the top of the screen a header block holds an uppercase kicker, the mainline goal sentence and a progress count. Text allowed: one uppercase kicker, one short Simplified Chinese goal sentence, a progress fraction, seven tiny ring labels.
shots.negative_extra: progress bar, milestone list, timeline list, dashboard
shots.notes: 禁止出现状态文字（已完成/进行中/未解锁），状态只能用样式表达。

shots.title: 档案 · 六维雷达与称号墙
shots.desc: 宿主档案：六边等级牌（沿轮廓走的经验环）＋金币，六维雷达（4 环 + 6 轴 + 每轴 3 枚刻度，刻度走平方根，低值外扩，避免偏科变成一根针），战绩四格，称号墙（锁着的显示？？？），道具库存。面板是从她胸口打出的光束托起来的，不是从屏幕底部长出来的。
shots.variation: A tall holographic projection sheet has slid up from the bottom of the screen, floating between her and the viewer and lit from her chest by a wide triangular cyan light beam; she is visible behind the sheet, dimmed. The sheet is the host archive: a hexagonal level plate holding a number and a thin experience arc, a coin readout beside it, a title string, a six-axis radar chart with four concentric grid rings and one filled polygon, a row of four statistic counters, a wall of title chips with some locked and shown as question marks, and an inventory row of four item icons. Text allowed: uppercase kickers, a few numbers, a few short Simplified Chinese labels.
shots.negative_extra: flat dashboard, spreadsheet table, bar chart list
shots.notes: 雷达顶点默认不画点，只留多边形轮廓；数值悬浮才显。

shots.title: 补给 · 金币唯一去处
shots.desc: 四种道具：双倍卡、暴击卡、免死金牌、换单券。金币只能花在这，买不起的行自动变灰。她会在旁边损你一句。
shots.variation: The projection sheet now shows the supply shop: four rows, each with a glowing item glyph on the left (a doubled hexagon, a starburst, a shield, and a circular swap arrow), an item name and a one-line description in the middle, and a hexagonal coin price button on the right. One row is greyed out and disabled because the price is unaffordable. A coin balance sits in the sheet header. She leans in from behind the sheet with a smug expression. Text allowed: four short Simplified Chinese item names, four prices, one balance number.
shots.negative_extra: real money, credit card, paywall, in-app purchase screen
shots.notes: 全程没有真实货币，只有金币。

shots.title: 系统设置 · 从她胸口打出的光束
shots.desc: 音效、她的声音（电子音节 / 人声 / 静音）、震动、全息描边、重置存档。面板由一条从她胸口打上去的青色光束托着——她不是背景，她是这个界面的电源。
shots.variation: The projection sheet shows a minimal settings console: five rows, each with a label, a one-line grey sub-caption and a two or three position segmented glass toggle on the right; the last row is a red-outlined destructive button with a hold-to-confirm fill bar. Above the sheet, a wide triangular cyan light beam connects her chest to the top edge of the sheet. Text allowed: five short Simplified Chinese labels and a few short toggle words.
shots.negative_extra: smartphone settings app, iOS settings list, flat list
shots.notes: 重置那一行是红框，但红色只出现在边框，不许铺开。

shots.title: 主线达成 · 整轨亮起
shots.desc: 最后一环完成，所有环同时亮起，从脚下一路亮到头顶。她会说一段话——这是整个产品唯一一次她不再毒舌。
shots.variation: Every ring track around her has ignited at once into a solid blazing ladder of light from her feet to far above her head, and she stands inside it with both arms slightly out, head up, eyes closed, wearing a genuinely warm expression for the first time. A huge burst of cyan particles and a white flash flood the frame. A centred banner holds an uppercase mainline-complete kicker, the goal sentence in large type, and a day count. Text allowed: one uppercase kicker, one Simplified Chinese goal sentence, one count.
shots.negative_extra: fireworks cartoon, trophy, medal, confetti
shots.notes: 唯一一次允许她「不毒舌」。表情要收着，不要喜极而泣。

shots.title: 战报 · 一张想发出去的图
shots.desc: 结算完给一张 900×1600 的战报 PNG，真的能导出、真的能发。上半是她的半身剪影压在暗底上，下半是稀有度、任务名、EXP、标签行，最后挂上她说的那句话。
shots.variation: A vertical shareable battle-report card rendered as a flat graphic with no perspective: near-black background with a faint cyan grid, a faded oversized watermark word behind everything, a hard-cut band across the upper half holding a dimmed silhouette of the girl, then a stacked lower section with a huge glowing rarity letter, an uppercase clear kicker, a task title, a huge EXP number, a row of small reward tags, one quoted line of Simplified Chinese dialogue with a small attribution, and a footer line with the host name, level and date. Text allowed: several short labels, one big number, one quoted Simplified Chinese line.
shots.negative_extra: social media frame, phone mockup, instagram story template
shots.notes: 真实实现是 canvas 画的（flows.js shareCard），这张只做视觉参照。

shots.title: 组件层 · HUD 与底栏
shots.desc: 常驻四层包裹里的第一层：等级六边牌带经验弧、金币六边计数、执行中计时 pill、贴顶 4px 经验条、底栏三页签加中央委托按钮、两枚玻璃选择按钮。全部贴边，中心永远留给角色。
shots.variation: A component sheet on a flat dark navy background with no character at all: the always-on game HUD parts laid out in a clean evenly spaced grid, each isolated with thin cyan guide lines. The parts are a hexagonal level badge with a thin experience arc, a hexagonal coin counter, a small running-timer pill, a thin full-width top experience bar, a bottom navigation bar with three small icon tabs and one large circular central button ringed by two thin orbiting arcs, and a pair of glass choice buttons. Text allowed: a few uppercase labels and numbers.
shots.negative_extra: character, girl, face, hands
shots.notes: 做 Flutter 组件时的对照图，尺寸标注另出。

shots.title: 打瞌睡 · 没人理她
shots.desc: 80 秒没人理她，她站着睡着了，环变慢、光变暗。你一碰她就醒，还嘴硬。这一屏是「她是个活的」最便宜也最有效的一次证明。
shots.variation: She has fallen asleep standing up: eyes closed, head drooped forward, body sagging slightly, her holographic brightness lowered and the ring tracks around her slowed and dimmed. Small cyan particles drift and a soft haze hangs around her. A single short subtitle card near her waist holds one sleepy line of Simplified Chinese dialogue with a slow five-bar waveform icon. Text allowed: one short Simplified Chinese line.
shots.negative_extra: zzz symbols, sleep bubble, cartoon snoring
shots.notes: 不许出现 zzz 气泡那种漫画符号。

shots.title: 冷场 · 连击断了 / 好几天没来
shots.desc: 她记得你断了几天的连击。这一档她话变短、眼神变平、色温更冷，环的呼吸变慢。毒舌升级是有数据支撑的：她会念出你真实的连败次数。
shots.variation: She stands with her arms loosely at her sides, chin level, eyes flat and half-lidded with no smirk at all, radiating cold disinterest. The holographic rim light on her contour is thinner and cooler than usual, the ring tracks around her are dim and breathing slowly, and the frame is very slightly desaturated compared with a normal lobby screen. One short subtitle card near her waist holds a single short Simplified Chinese line. Text allowed: one short Simplified Chinese line.
shots.negative_extra: angry face, shouting, red eyes, harsh lighting
shots.notes: 这一档的关键是「更冷」而不是「更凶」——把表情减到最少。

shots.title: 今日已清 · 等换日
shots.desc: 当日委托清空。中央那颗大按钮从「委托」变成「今日已清」，底下写着换日还有多久，她会预告明天的等级。这一屏要传达的不是空，是「今天已经没事了」的松弛感。
shots.variation: A calm end-of-day lobby: she stands at the centre with her weight shifted and her arms behind her back, looking at the viewer with a small self-satisfied expression. The large circular central button at the bottom is dimmed and empty, with a short Simplified Chinese caption underneath reading that today is clear plus a countdown to the next day, and a second small line predicting tomorrow. No task panel anywhere on screen, the stage is uncluttered. Text allowed: two short Simplified Chinese captions and one small level prediction label.
shots.negative_extra: empty state illustration, sad empty box, zero data
shots.notes: 空不是缺，是清空后的安静。
